sql: SELECT T1.birth_region FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T2.role = 'assistant location manager'

SELECT T1.year, T1.episode_id FROM Award AS T1 INNER JOIN Person AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T2.name = 'Constantine Makris' AND T1.result = 'Winner' AND T1.award = 'Television' AND T1.award_category = 'Silver Gavel Award' AND T1.organization = 'American Bar Association Silver Gavel Awards for Media and the Arts'

SELECT COUNT(T1.award_id) FROM Award AS T1 INNER JOIN Episode AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T2.episode = 20 AND T1.series = 'Law and Order' AND T1.organization = 'Primetime Emmy Awards' AND T1.year = 1999 AND T1.result = 'Nominee'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.birth_country = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.person_id), T1.role FROM Credit AS T1 INNER JOIN Person AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id INNER JOIN Episode AS T3 ON T1.episode_id = T3.episode_id WHERE T3.episode = 2 AND T1.category = 'Cast'
